BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state veterans' song; and adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The song, music, and lyrics, "Thanks to Them," composed by JerryHayes, is hereby designated as the official veterans' song of the stateof Washington.
